verdict.rationale: Anytype documents self-hosting its sync and backup network using a network configuration, with a team-maintained Docker image (anytype-docs-6, anytype-docs-19, anytype-docs-63). The app itself runs locally and offline-first, offers a local-only mode, and its CLI can run Anytype as a headless server (anytype-docs-29, anytype-docs-30, anytype-docs-2, anytype-docs-71). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, detailed setup and operations docs beyond brief mentions, and a smoother migration path (switching network mode requires exporting and re-importing into a new identity per anytype-docs-23).
